title: Theft of secured accessories
body_md: If the radio cable loop is triggered – for example when camping accessories secured with it are stolen – the connected alarm system reports this through Pro-finder. An additional callback to the master number is **not** stated for this message type.
source_region: Chapter 4, explanation of the message type “Theft of accessories”
prev_context: The manual alarm ends on the previous page.
next_context: Chapter 5 begins on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 20: equivalent in substance – the red addition about the callback carried by the four preceding message types is missing there too. The omission is therefore independently confirmed and is not a reading error; whether it is intended, the source does not say. In the English version this message type is the only one on a page of its own, and this is the point at which the English part compensates the page displacement recorded in DSC-021.
